name: Passkey MFA Sign-In
summary: Completes a password-issued MFA challenge with a user-verified Passkey and adapts the accepted proof to either the browser-session or mobile-token completion path.

sourceReferences.note: The shared proof service validates provider=passkey against the password-issued MFA challenge, derives the expected UserId from that challenge, delegates user-bound WebAuthn proof, and consumes the MFA challenge only after proof succeeds.
Browser and mobile endpoints share the proof service and differ only in application-session versus token-session completion after a proven AppUser is returned.
